description: c115 server-pillar coverage: proves PerfectDarkServer.exe boots cleanly to the main loop on a vanilla, no-config invocation. As of c115 (2026-05-15) smoke_harness.c is compiled into pd-server (CMakeLists.txt SRC_SERVER), so this test uses runtime_strategy='harness' for a scripted clean exit and a reliable exit-code-0 result. Confirms the canonical boot sequence: sysInit -> fsInit -> updaterInit (skipped via --no-update-check) -> assetCatalogInit + base BYOR registration -> netInit -> hubInit -> serverBansInit (clean install -> 'no ban file' marker) -> serverAdminInit (no token -> 'no admin token configured' marker) -> SDL_Init (headless via --headless) -> netStartServer -> 'Listening on port' -> 'Entering main loop' -> smokeHarnessInit (no events scheduled apart from the scripted exit) -> first smokeHarnessTick fires the exit event -> SMOKE: result=scripted_exit code=0. Note: the 'NET: dedicated server mode enabled' line in netInit() is gated on sysArgCheck('--dedicated') (the in-client path), not on g_NetDedicated -- it fires for the client launched with --dedicated, not for the standalone PerfectDarkServer.exe, so this test does NOT assert it. The dedicated path skips the ROM hash check at CLC_AUTH (per context/pillars/server.md): no ROM is loaded, so this test does NOT seed a ROM file in the install dir (Install-Harness.ps1's Target=pd-server branch). Failure modes guarded: ENet init failure (NET: could not init ENet), bind failure (NET: could not create ENet host on port), unexpected ROM check firing (would only happen if g_NetDedicated invariant breaks), and a SERVER: Failed to start error log. Anchors the server-pillar bring-up regression.

input_sequence.comment: boot marker -- the harness emits SMOKE: harness init / scenario= lines on smokeHarnessInit, then the first smokeHarnessTick walks any due events. Action/key/mouse injection is no-op on pd-server (no input pipeline) so this test relies on wait/exit only.

scripted clean shutdown at 5s -- well after the 'Entering main loop' marker (recorded server boot lands it around 1.5s). smokeHarnessExit writes SMOKE: result=scripted_exit code=0 and calls exit(0), giving the runner a deterministic non-timeout outcome to assert against.

required_lines: BANS: no ban file at .* \(0 bans loaded\)
forbidden_patterns: NET: could not init ENet, disabling networking
NET: could not create ENet host on port \d+
